Since \(\log\) is base \(10\),
\[
\log_8 1000=\log_2 10=\frac{1}{\log 2}.
\]
Thus
\[
x_1=\log(\log_2 10)=\log\left(\frac1{\log 2}\right)=-\log(\log 2)=-x_2.
\]

Also,
\[
\frac1{a^{-x}-1}+\frac12=-\left(\frac1{a^x-1}+\frac12\right),
\]
so the entire nonconstant part of \(f\) is odd. Hence
\[
f(x)+f(-x)=12.
\]
Therefore
\[
f(x_1)=f(-x_2)=12-f(x_2).
\]
Given \(f(x_1)=8\),
\[
8=12-f(x_2) \implies f(x_2)=4.
\]

\[
\boxed{4}
\]
